messages:
Sasha (product): Quick thread to align on the discovery/probe endpoint shape and launch criteria for model capability flags. Two enterprise asks: Acme needs explicit tool lists + per-model token caps, Nimbus needs streaming support guarantees.
Trevor (eng-runtime): For MVP I suggest /v1/models/:id/features returning a compact summary + links. Minimal shape idea: `{"features": ["streaming", "function_calling", "structured_output"], "limits": {"context_tokens": 8192}}`
Elaine (eng-ml): For embeddings models we should include `embedding_dim` and `batching_supported` in the same discovery response so clients can adapt.
Mohit (infra): Concern: customer requests include huge tool manifests — we shouldn't ship full lists on every call. Propose a `cap_flags_version` and `tools_manifest_url` (signed) to avoid payload bloat. ETag + TTL caching.
Jia (solutions): Sales feedback: prioritize these boolean flags — `supports_function_calling`, `supports_streaming`, `supports_json_schema` — they directly unblock deals. Also expose `max_input_tokens` and `max_output_tokens` clearly.
Sasha (product): Draft launch criteria proposal: 1) endpoint returns canonical flags + limits, 2) streaming flag correctly reflects SSE/websocket modes, 3) docs + curl sample, 4) two customer validation sessions (Acme + Nimbus), 5) rollback/fallback policy to a compatible model variant.
Trevor (eng-runtime): Implementation note: flags can be computed at model onboarding and stored as metadata. For streaming include `streaming_modes`: ["chunked", "event_stream"] and `recommended_latency_slo_ms`.
Mohit (infra): Also recommend `flags_etag` and `manifest_hash` fields. Infra will enforce a size limit and return a `tools_manifest_url` if the manifest > 8kb.
Elaine (eng-ml): Acceptance QA: require three golden prompts per customer with expected structured outputs; automated eval runs must show <5% regression on those prompts before launch.
Jia (solutions): One more sales ask: `tool_schema_url` should be accessible for hosted Dedicated but redacted for Private unless customer opts in. Add opt-in header.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: model-discovery-service v1 -> staging at 2024-11-05T10:00Z (CI pipeline ID 4821)
Sasha (product): Decision for now: server-side computed cap_flags + small inline summary + link to full manifest. ETag + TTL required. Trevor & Mohit: please draft API spec + infra plan by EOD Friday.
Trevor (eng-runtime): Will do. Quick proto snippet to iterate on: `{"features": ["streaming", "function_calling"], "limits": {"context_tokens": 4096, "max_input_tokens": 3072, "max_output_tokens": 1024}, "flags_etag": "v1.3"}`
Mohit (infra): :thumbsup: I'll include caching, signed manifest URLs, and a migration plan for old model metadata.
Jia (solutions): I'll set up customer validation slots next Wed/Thu and share the test prompts.
Sasha (product): Thanks — we'll reconvene after the API draft. If anyone hits blockers (esp. around token-accounting semantics) flag here and we'll escalate to Platform PMs.
